context: A mom helps her young son sort his closet
purpose: Teach: ワケ/さほど/ストック/めぐり/トータル/ボディ/スロー/主として

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、クローゼットを片付けようか。服のストックがたまりすぎちゃってね。
lines.en: Sho, shall we tidy up the closet? Our stock of clothes has piled up too much.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, gentle but firm encouragement to start the task together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー、なんで今日?急に言われてもワケわかんないよ。
lines.en: Aww, why today? You spring it on me and I have no idea why.
lines.style: Whiny child voice with drawn-out vowels showing reluctance and mild protest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さほど大変じゃないよ。トータルで三十分くらいで終わるから。
lines.en: It's not that bad. It'll be done in about thirty minutes total.
lines.style: Reassuring practical tone, slightly bright to motivate the reluctant child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあさ、このヒーローのボディがプリントされたTシャツはどうするの?
lines.en: Then what about this T-shirt with the hero's body printed on it?
lines.style: Curious child voice brightening with interest as he holds up a favorite shirt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それもうサイズ小さいよね。主として今着てる服を残すようにしよう。
lines.en: That's already too small, right? Let's mainly keep the clothes you wear now.
lines.style: Patient maternal explanation, gentle but guiding toward a clear decision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん…でもさ、もうちょっとスローなペースで見ていい?思い出めぐりしたいんだ。
lines.en: Hmm... but can we go at a slower pace? I want to take a memory tour.
lines.style: Soft contemplative child voice slowing down as nostalgia gently hits him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいよ、一枚ずつゆっくりね。ママもこの帽子見たら懐かしくなっちゃった。
lines.en: Sure, slowly one by one. Seeing this hat made me feel nostalgic too.
lines.style: Warm affectionate tone slowing pace to share the tender moment with her son.
